query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[2] You will learn why dairy, even organic dairy, may not be the best foods for women who suffer from PMS, PMDD or irregular cycles. You will also learn why conventionally raised animal protein, typical in a U.S. diet and very low-carb diets are problematic for women who present with PMS/PMDD symptoms.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.
URL: https://draxe.com/pms-symptoms/

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[9] Welcome to The Cycle Diet. You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.
URL: https://draxe.com/pms-symptoms/

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.

query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[2] You will learn why dairy, even organic dairy, may not be the best foods for women who suffer from PMS, PMDD or irregular cycles. You will also learn why conventionally raised animal protein, typical in a U.S. diet and very low-carb diets are problematic for women who present with PMS/PMDD symptoms.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.
URL: https://draxe.com/pms-symptoms/

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[9] Welcome to The Cycle Diet. You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[1] Other herbs for headache: Meadowsweet, valerian (excellent if you can't sleep), skullcap, chamomile (also common for relaxation). Boswellia is an herb than has recently been recommended for migraine. Recent studies point to butterbur extract (petasites hybridus root) as a migraine treatment.
URL: http://www.relieve-migraine-headache.com/herb_for_headache.html

[2] There are several herbs which are used as natural remedies for headaches. These include feverfew, skullcap, ginger, and chamomile. Here are some recipes for herbal teas that can soothe migraines and tension headaches, in lieu of over-the-counter or prescription medications.
URL: http://braincoretherapy.com/four-herbal-teas-natural-remedies-headaches/

[3] Headaches can be debilitating, but there are a variety of herbal remedies to treat them. By taking preventative natural medicines or treating headaches with herbs, you can ward off or successfully treat painful headaches -- either light or intense ones.
URL: http://health.howstuffworks.com/wellness/natural-medicine/herbal-remedies/herbal-remedies-for-headaches.htm

[4] 1 Evening primrose oil, another best herb for headaches, helps dilate blood vessels, helping with headache pain. 2  Take 500 Mg capsules two or three times daily or as directed. 3  Valerian is the last of best herbs for headaches that is a stress reducer and helps with headache pain.
URL: http://www.help-for-migraines.com/best-herbs-for-headaches.html

URL: http://www.help-for-migraines.com/best-herbs-for-headaches.html

[7] Make a tea or tincture of these herbs at the first sign of a headache and drink a cup or two. You can also include herbs such as lavender and mullein. On the other hand, if you're looking more for muscle relaxation, add chamomile, rosemary, or mint.Do not use feverfew if you are pregnant or nursing.
URL: http://health.howstuffworks.com/wellness/natural-medicine/herbal-remedies/herbal-remedies-for-headaches.htm

[8] Not only does lavender smell great — it's also a useful home remedy for headaches and migraine pain. Lavender oil can be either inhaled or applied topically. Two to four drops for every two to three cups of boiling water are recommended when inhaling lavender-oil vapors as a headache treatment.
URL: http://www.everydayhealth.com/headache-migraine-pictures/8-home-remedies-for-headaches-and-migraines.aspx

[9] Feverfew, the best herb for headache pain. Feverfew is the top one for decreasing the frequency and intensity of headaches and migraines. 1  Feverfew is a flowering plant that's been used since ancient times to treat migraines and inflammation.
URL: http://www.help-for-migraines.com/best-herbs-for-headaches.html

[10] There are a few other herbal remedies that can be used for headaches, such as valerian and passion flower. Both have sedative qualities and are best used before retiring. Regardless of how safe all of them are, consult an herbalist or health practitioner knowledgeable about herbs to ensure optimum results.

query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[2] You will learn why dairy, even organic dairy, may not be the best foods for women who suffer from PMS, PMDD or irregular cycles. You will also learn why conventionally raised animal protein, typical in a U.S. diet and very low-carb diets are problematic for women who present with PMS/PMDD symptoms.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.
URL: https://draxe.com/pms-symptoms/

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[9] Welcome to The Cycle Diet. You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

query: best remedy to dry out feet blisters
sources:
[1] Most blisters heal on their own. Home treatment may help decrease pain, prevent infection, and help heal large or broken blisters. 1  A small, unbroken blister about the size of a pea, even a blood blister, will usually heal on its own. 2  Use a loose bandage to protect it. 3  Avoid the activity that caused the blister.

[2] 1 Leave the area over the blister open. 2  It's best not to drain a blister at home. 3  But when blisters are painful, some people do drain them. 4  If you do decide to drain your blister, be sure to follow these steps: 5  Wipe a needle or straight pin with rubbing alcohol. 6  Gently puncture the edge of the blister.

[3] Home Remedies for Treating Blisters. A blister is your body's way of telling you that skin and tissues are being injured. So it's important to take steps to relieve the discomfort and protect the injured area. If you have a blister, read these helpful home remedies to treat your feet: Make a tent.

[4] Home Remedies for Treating Blisters. A blister is your body's way of telling you that skin and tissues are being injured. So it's important to take steps to relieve the discomfort and protect the injured area. If you have a blister, read these helpful home remedies to treat your feet:

[5] Blisters are worsened by moisture and friction, so keeping your feet bone dry can help prevent them from forming. Slide the gel variety around the sides and tops of clean, dry feet before slipping on a new pair of shoes; the deodorant should act as a home remedy to lubricate any problem areas and reduce rubbing.

[6] To drain a blister that is large, painful, or in an awkward spot: 1  Wash the area. 2  Sterilize a needle with rubbing alcohol or soap and water. 3  Make a small hole at the edge of the blister. 4  Gently squeeze out the fluid. 5  Wash the blister again and pat dry. 6  Don’t remove the skin over the blister. 7  Smooth down the skin flap.

[7] Castor oil is a popular home remedy for blisters. What to do: Apply before you go to bed, and let sit overnight to help your blister dry up and heal. You can mix the castor oil with apple cider vinegar to further aid healing.

[8] Plus, it reduces the risk of infection. Aloe Vera and Vitamin E Oil Home Remedy to Heal your Foot Blisters. 1  Apply fresh aloe vera gel on the blister and allow it to dry on its own. 2  Rinse it off with warm water. 3  Another option is to prepare a mixture with equal amounts of aloe vera gel and vitamin E oil.

[9] Apple cider vinegar is also a very effective remedy for blisters on the foot due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. It can help prevent infection and reduce pain and inflammation. 1  Dip a cotton ball into apple cider vinegar. 2  Gently swab it around the affected area and allow it to dry.

[10] Home remedies for foot blisters can include the use or application of apple cider vinegar, castor oil, antibacterial ointment, pads, warm water, Vaseline or any petroleum gel, Aloe Vera gel and Epsom salt.

query: What is the best beretta for home defense?
sources:
[1] I'll weigh in since I own variations of both of your choices. The Beretta 92fs is a good gun for a first home defense gun, so long as you're only considering a pistol and not a 12 gauge shotgun (which I would also recommend).The Beretta can take high capacity magazines, is quite accurate, and is a very reliable pistol.
URL: https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20111221101204AAETWpU

[2] 1. CZ-75 SP-01: This is one of the best 9mm Handgun for Self-Defense I have ever seen, the plus point of this handgun is that it is a NATO certified gun and it's used by Czech police.
URL: http://geekstopten.com/10-best-9mm-handguns-self-defense/

[3] A rundown of the six best shotguns for home defense, including releases by Mossberg, Wilson Combat, Beretta and more.
URL: http://www.personaldefenseworld.com/2014/07/top-6-shotguns-home-security/

[4] Collapse. The 1301 is designed to give demanding tactical shotgun shooters the most desirable features right out of the box. With its compact size, ghost-ring sights, oversized controls and lightning-quick operation, it is possibly today's best shotgun for law enforcement, home defense and even 3-gun competition.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[5] The SIG Sauer Tac Ops 1911 with Threaded Barrel is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Para Ordnance 1911's, Kimber 1911's, Customs, the list goes on and on…. Pros: All steel build, makes the .45 ACP manageable for just about anyone.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[6] The Beretta 92 is a great pistol for beginners due to the weight and ease of acquiring a sight picture. The magazine capacity of 15-rounds makes it a suitable choice for home defense or as a duty pistol for law-enforcement.The weight has some drawbacks as does the size for concealed carry.
URL: http://besthandgun.com/beretta-m92/

[7] 1301 Tactical: Ultimate Reliability for Home-Defense, Law-Enforcement. The 1301 is Beretta's new gas operated semi-automatic shotgun designed for law-enforcement and home-defense. Engineered to be ultra-reliable and easy to use, it has all the features that a modern tactical shotgun should offer—and more.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[8] The Glock 19 is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Steyr Pistols, All Glocks, Kahr Arms various models. Pros: Easy to use, take apart, put together, clean, and upgrade for any home defense need. Cons: No manual safeties come standard with a Glock.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[9] And when used with the extended mag (I would recommend this for home defense use) it is an easy gun to control. The Smith & Wesson M&P Shield is of the best handguns for self defense. Comparable: Springfield XD subcompact, Glock subcompact.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[10] Baby eagle is available in many calibers like 9mm, .45 ACP, .40 S&W, etc and in both Polymer and Steel frame with several Barrel lengths. The one I like is this, Full sized Baby Eagle 2 9mm with steel frame which is surely a Great deal, pretty much accurate. An Ideal 9mm handgun for Self-defense scenarios.

[5] Toyota Celica. For many teens, owning a sports car is nothing more than a distant dream. But parents and teens can find the ultimate compromise in the Toyota Celica. [6] Lifestyle 7/18/2014 @ 8:32PM 85,728 views. The Safest Used Cars For Teen Drivers. Those are the findings of new research conducted by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, a nonprofit financed by the insurance industry.

[7] [Slideshow: Safest Cars for Teens] Teens that have their own vehicle drive their vehicle more and are more likely to be in a crash, just because of that, says Anne McCartt, senior vice president of research at the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety.

query: best way to quit caffeine
sources:
[1] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills. 4  Caffeine pills contain more caffeine than most people think -- about 200 mg.

[2] Well, you can! Caffeine is a drug, and like any drug, in order to free yourself from addiction, you have to be committed to your plan of action, and be ready for the pain and of withdrawal. The key to quitting is the knowledge that things will get worse before they get better, but it will get better.

[3] 1 The third week, use 1/2 and 1/2. 2  The fourth week, use 1/4 regular and 3/4 decaf. 3  The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 4  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[4] 1 The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 2  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[5] Whichever the reason, quitting caffeine isn’t easy since most people develop a strong dependance on the daily dose; both physically and mentally. There are generally two ways to detox from caffeine and we describe each of those methods below.

[6] 1 Don't start drinking too much caffeine! 2  The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 3  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version.

[7] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills.

[8] Don't go at it alone. Find someone to quit with you. If you can't find that kind of support, promise to someone whom you love and respect that you will quit caffeine. Thus, consuming caffeine in any form will make you break your promise, and this will provide you with another incentive to stay on the wagon.

[9] And in every situation, you're going to need a substitute.. Quitting caffeine isn't easy, but if you feel your consumption has become a bad habit, the best way to break it is to create a new one to put in its place. Enter, our list of the best coffee alternatives to help you kick your caffeine dependency -- for good.

[10] If you choose the cold turkey method it’s important that you know what to expect and to prepare in advance for the debilitating withdrawal symptoms that can follow. 1  Plan ahead so that the first couple days of detox fall on a weekend or work holiday. 2  Have pain relievers on hand and avoid driving.

[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[9] Welcome to The Cycle Diet. You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.

query: best way to quit caffeine
sources:
[1] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills. 4  Caffeine pills contain more caffeine than most people think -- about 200 mg.

[2] Well, you can! Caffeine is a drug, and like any drug, in order to free yourself from addiction, you have to be committed to your plan of action, and be ready for the pain and of withdrawal. The key to quitting is the knowledge that things will get worse before they get better, but it will get better.

[3] 1 The third week, use 1/2 and 1/2. 2  The fourth week, use 1/4 regular and 3/4 decaf. 3  The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 4  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[4] 1 The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 2  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[5] Whichever the reason, quitting caffeine isn’t easy since most people develop a strong dependance on the daily dose; both physically and mentally. There are generally two ways to detox from caffeine and we describe each of those methods below.

[6] 1 Don't start drinking too much caffeine! 2  The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 3  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version.

[7] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills.

[8] Don't go at it alone. Find someone to quit with you. If you can't find that kind of support, promise to someone whom you love and respect that you will quit caffeine. Thus, consuming caffeine in any form will make you break your promise, and this will provide you with another incentive to stay on the wagon.

[9] And in every situation, you're going to need a substitute.. Quitting caffeine isn't easy, but if you feel your consumption has become a bad habit, the best way to break it is to create a new one to put in its place. Enter, our list of the best coffee alternatives to help you kick your caffeine dependency -- for good.

[10] If you choose the cold turkey method it’s important that you know what to expect and to prepare in advance for the debilitating withdrawal symptoms that can follow. 1  Plan ahead so that the first couple days of detox fall on a weekend or work holiday. 2  Have pain relievers on hand and avoid driving.

query: best natural sources of calcium
sources:
[1] Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams. Kale, broccoli, Swiss chard, bok choy and turnip greens are full of calcium, too.

[2] Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli. Spinach provides calcium, but its bioavailability is poor.

[3] Here are 5 of the best natural sources of calcium for healthy bones. Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams.

[4] Here are 5 of the best natural sources of calcium for healthy bones. Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams. Kale, broccoli, Swiss chard, bok choy and turnip greens are full of calcium, too.

[5] Food. Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli.

[6] Milk and dairy products are some of the best food sources of calcium. These include milk, yogurt, and cheese. Broccoli helps to increase the intake of calcium, and is thus a very good source of calcium. Certain foods such as fruit juices and drinks, cereals, and tofu, are fortified with calcium.

[7] However, other excellent sources of calcium exist. Sources of well-absorbed calcium for vegans include calcium-fortified soy milk and juice, calcium-set tofu, soybeans and soynuts, bok choy, broccoli, collards, Chinese cabbage, kale, mustard greens, and okra.

[8] Sources of Calcium. Food. Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli.

[9] Calcium supplements offer a good source of calcium and help protect bones and teeth. Most commonly, calcium is present in supplements mainly in the form of carbonates and citrates. It is also present in supplements or certain fortified foods in the form of phosphates, gluconates, and lactates, to some extent.

query: best way to quit caffeine
sources:
[1] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills. 4  Caffeine pills contain more caffeine than most people think -- about 200 mg.

[2] Well, you can! Caffeine is a drug, and like any drug, in order to free yourself from addiction, you have to be committed to your plan of action, and be ready for the pain and of withdrawal. The key to quitting is the knowledge that things will get worse before they get better, but it will get better.

[3] 1 The third week, use 1/2 and 1/2. 2  The fourth week, use 1/4 regular and 3/4 decaf. 3  The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 4  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[4] 1 The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 2  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[5] Whichever the reason, quitting caffeine isn’t easy since most people develop a strong dependance on the daily dose; both physically and mentally. There are generally two ways to detox from caffeine and we describe each of those methods below.

[6] 1 Don't start drinking too much caffeine! 2  The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 3  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version.

[7] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills.

[8] Don't go at it alone. Find someone to quit with you. If you can't find that kind of support, promise to someone whom you love and respect that you will quit caffeine. Thus, consuming caffeine in any form will make you break your promise, and this will provide you with another incentive to stay on the wagon.

[9] And in every situation, you're going to need a substitute.. Quitting caffeine isn't easy, but if you feel your consumption has become a bad habit, the best way to break it is to create a new one to put in its place. Enter, our list of the best coffee alternatives to help you kick your caffeine dependency -- for good.

[10] If you choose the cold turkey method it’s important that you know what to expect and to prepare in advance for the debilitating withdrawal symptoms that can follow. 1  Plan ahead so that the first couple days of detox fall on a weekend or work holiday. 2  Have pain relievers on hand and avoid driving.

query: best natural sources of calcium
sources:
[1] Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams. Kale, broccoli, Swiss chard, bok choy and turnip greens are full of calcium, too.

[2] Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli. Spinach provides calcium, but its bioavailability is poor.

[3] Here are 5 of the best natural sources of calcium for healthy bones. Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams.

[4] Here are 5 of the best natural sources of calcium for healthy bones. Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium. One cup of boiled collards contains a whopping 358 milligrams. Kale, broccoli, Swiss chard, bok choy and turnip greens are full of calcium, too.

[5] Food. Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli.

[6] Milk and dairy products are some of the best food sources of calcium. These include milk, yogurt, and cheese. Broccoli helps to increase the intake of calcium, and is thus a very good source of calcium. Certain foods such as fruit juices and drinks, cereals, and tofu, are fortified with calcium.

[7] However, other excellent sources of calcium exist. Sources of well-absorbed calcium for vegans include calcium-fortified soy milk and juice, calcium-set tofu, soybeans and soynuts, bok choy, broccoli, collards, Chinese cabbage, kale, mustard greens, and okra.

[8] Sources of Calcium. Food. Milk, yogurt, and cheese are rich natural sources of calcium and are the major food contributors of this nutrient to people in the United States [ 1 ]. Nondairy sources include vegetables, such as Chinese cabbage, kale, and broccoli.

[9] Calcium supplements offer a good source of calcium and help protect bones and teeth. Most commonly, calcium is present in supplements mainly in the form of carbonates and citrates. It is also present in supplements or certain fortified foods in the form of phosphates, gluconates, and lactates, to some extent.

[10] Here are 5 of the best natural sources of calcium for healthy bones. Collard Greens. Leafy green vegetables are one of the most healthful sources of calcium and magnesium.

query: list of the best suv cars for teens
sources:
[1] New SUVs that are safe for your family and teen driver include the midsize 2015 Toyota Highlander, as well as the compact 2015 Mazda CX-5, Mitsubishi Outlander (AWD only) and Subaru Forester. These SUVs are both IIHS Top Safety Pick+ recipients and have NHTSA's highest five-star overall rating.

[2] Safest Cars for Teens: SUVs. If a large, dull sedan isn't your teen's ideal first car, McCartt suggests shopping for an SUV. With ESC dramatically reducing rollover risk, the inherent advantages offered by SUVs' greater size, weight and height emerge more clearly, the IIHS says in its January 2015 status report.

[3] As icing on the proverbial cake, each of the models on the best cars for teen drivers list carries reasonably low car-insurance rates – or at least as far as teen drivers are concerned.

[4] We selected the 15 cars on this list the pillars of safety, reliability, and affordability. And despite what you might expect, not all the cars are compact and midsize sedans. A number of models, including large SUVs and a few sports cars, are suitable choices for first-time drivers.

[5] Toyota Celica. For many teens, owning a sports car is nothing more than a distant dream. But parents and teens can find the ultimate compromise in the Toyota Celica. Once they get over the shock of seeing a cassette player for the first time, teens will enjoy this car just as much as their parents did.

[6] Lifestyle 7/18/2014 @ 8:32PM 85,728 views. The Safest Used Cars For Teen Drivers. Teenagers are more likely than other drivers to have the least safe types of cars, often ending up behind the wheel of vehicles that are old, small and without good crash protection. Those are the findings of new research conducted by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, a nonprofit financed by the insurance industry.

[7] [Slideshow: Safest Cars for Teens] Teens that have their own vehicle drive their vehicle more and are more likely to be in a crash, just because of that, says Anne McCartt, senior vice president of research at the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety.

[8] To that end, the experts at CarInsurance.com recently compiled a list of 14 used cars that should be ideal for teen drivers; we’re featuring them in the accompanying slideshow with our own commentary. Each is from the 2009 model year and is valued at $15,000 or less according to Edmunds.com.

[9] Earlier this week the group released a list of recommended used vehicles to help parents buy safe cars within their budgets, ranging from less than $5,000 to nearly $20,000. “A teenager’s first car is more than just a financial decision,” Adrian Lund, the institute’s president, said in a statement.

[10] Note that pickups and sport-utility vehicles were deliberately left off the list of best cars for teen drivers for apparent safety concerns. “While some pickups and SUVs score well, they’re really not great choices for novice drivers,” says CarInsurance.com consumer analyst Penny Gusner.

query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[2] You will learn why dairy, even organic dairy, may not be the best foods for women who suffer from PMS, PMDD or irregular cycles. You will also learn why conventionally raised animal protein, typical in a U.S. diet and very low-carb diets are problematic for women who present with PMS/PMDD symptoms.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

query: list of the best suv cars for teens
sources:
[1] New SUVs that are safe for your family and teen driver include the midsize 2015 Toyota Highlander, as well as the compact 2015 Mazda CX-5, Mitsubishi Outlander (AWD only) and Subaru Forester. These SUVs are both IIHS Top Safety Pick+ recipients and have NHTSA's highest five-star overall rating.

[2] Safest Cars for Teens: SUVs. If a large, dull sedan isn't your teen's ideal first car, McCartt suggests shopping for an SUV. With ESC dramatically reducing rollover risk, the inherent advantages offered by SUVs' greater size, weight and height emerge more clearly, the IIHS says in its January 2015 status report.

[3] As icing on the proverbial cake, each of the models on the best cars for teen drivers list carries reasonably low car-insurance rates – or at least as far as teen drivers are concerned.

[4] We selected the 15 cars on this list the pillars of safety, reliability, and affordability. And despite what you might expect, not all the cars are compact and midsize sedans. A number of models, including large SUVs and a few sports cars, are suitable choices for first-time drivers.

[5] Toyota Celica. For many teens, owning a sports car is nothing more than a distant dream. But parents and teens can find the ultimate compromise in the Toyota Celica. Once they get over the shock of seeing a cassette player for the first time, teens will enjoy this car just as much as their parents did.

[6] Lifestyle 7/18/2014 @ 8:32PM 85,728 views. The Safest Used Cars For Teen Drivers. Teenagers are more likely than other drivers to have the least safe types of cars, often ending up behind the wheel of vehicles that are old, small and without good crash protection. Those are the findings of new research conducted by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, a nonprofit financed by the insurance industry.

[7] [Slideshow: Safest Cars for Teens] Teens that have their own vehicle drive their vehicle more and are more likely to be in a crash, just because of that, says Anne McCartt, senior vice president of research at the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety.

[8] To that end, the experts at CarInsurance.com recently compiled a list of 14 used cars that should be ideal for teen drivers; we’re featuring them in the accompanying slideshow with our own commentary. Each is from the 2009 model year and is valued at $15,000 or less according to Edmunds.com.

[9] Earlier this week the group released a list of recommended used vehicles to help parents buy safe cars within their budgets, ranging from less than $5,000 to nearly $20,000. “A teenager’s first car is more than just a financial decision,” Adrian Lund, the institute’s president, said in a statement.

[10] Note that pickups and sport-utility vehicles were deliberately left off the list of best cars for teen drivers for apparent safety concerns. “While some pickups and SUVs score well, they’re really not great choices for novice drivers,” says CarInsurance.com consumer analyst Penny Gusner.

query: What is the best beretta for home defense?
sources:

The Beretta 92fs is a good gun for a first home defense gun, so long as you're only considering a pistol and not a 12 gauge shotgun (which I would also recommend).The Beretta can take high capacity magazines, is quite accurate, and is a very reliable pistol.
URL: https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20111221101204AAETWpU

[2] 1. CZ-75 SP-01: This is one of the best 9mm Handgun for Self-Defense I have ever seen, the plus point of this handgun is that it is a NATO certified gun and it's used by Czech police.
URL: http://geekstopten.com/10-best-9mm-handguns-self-defense/

[3] A rundown of the six best shotguns for home defense, including releases by Mossberg, Wilson Combat, Beretta and more.
URL: http://www.personaldefenseworld.com/2014/07/top-6-shotguns-home-security/

With its compact size, ghost-ring sights, oversized controls and lightning-quick operation, it is possibly today's best shotgun for law enforcement, home defense and even 3-gun competition.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[5] The SIG Sauer Tac Ops 1911 with Threaded Barrel is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Para Ordnance 1911's, Kimber 1911's, Customs, the list goes on and on…. Pros: All steel build, makes the .45 ACP manageable for just about anyone.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[6] The Beretta 92 is a great pistol for beginners due to the weight and ease of acquiring a sight picture. The magazine capacity of 15-rounds makes it a suitable choice for home defense or as a duty pistol for law-enforcement.The weight has some drawbacks as does the size for concealed carry.
URL: http://besthandgun.com/beretta-m92/

[7] 1301 Tactical: Ultimate Reliability for Home-Defense, Law-Enforcement. The 1301 is Beretta's new gas operated semi-automatic shotgun designed for law-enforcement and home-defense. Engineered to be ultra-reliable and easy to use, it has all the features that a modern tactical shotgun should offer—and more.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[8] The Glock 19 is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Steyr Pistols, All Glocks, Kahr Arms various models. Pros: Easy to use, take apart, put together, clean, and upgrade for any home defense need. Cons: No manual safeties come standard with a Glock.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[9] And when used with the extended mag (I would recommend this for home defense use) it is an easy gun to control. The Smith & Wesson M&P Shield is of the best handguns for self defense. Comparable: Springfield XD subcompact, Glock subcompact.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

query: best way to quit caffeine
sources:
[1] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills. 4  Caffeine pills contain more caffeine than most people think -- about 200 mg.

[2] Well, you can! Caffeine is a drug, and like any drug, in order to free yourself from addiction, you have to be committed to your plan of action, and be ready for the pain and of withdrawal. The key to quitting is the knowledge that things will get worse before they get better, but it will get better.

[3] 1 The third week, use 1/2 and 1/2. 2  The fourth week, use 1/4 regular and 3/4 decaf. 3  The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 4  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[4] 1 The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 2  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[5] Whichever the reason, quitting caffeine isn’t easy since most people develop a strong dependance on the daily dose; both physically and mentally. There are generally two ways to detox from caffeine and we describe each of those methods below.

[6] 1 Don't start drinking too much caffeine! 2  The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 3  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version.

[7] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills.

[8] Don't go at it alone. Find someone to quit with you. If you can't find that kind of support, promise to someone whom you love and respect that you will quit caffeine. Thus, consuming caffeine in any form will make you break your promise, and this will provide you with another incentive to stay on the wagon.

[9] And in every situation, you're going to need a substitute.. Quitting caffeine isn't easy, but if you feel your consumption has become a bad habit, the best way to break it is to create a new one to put in its place. Enter, our list of the best coffee alternatives to help you kick your caffeine dependency -- for good.

[10] If you choose the cold turkey method it’s important that you know what to expect and to prepare in advance for the debilitating withdrawal symptoms that can follow. 1  Plan ahead so that the first couple days of detox fall on a weekend or work holiday. 2  Have pain relievers on hand and avoid driving.
